prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic high-angle athletic lifestyle portrait of an approved adult platinum-blonde woman in a bright minimalist room.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with sleek platinum-blonde hair, fair natural skin, light green eyes, defined brows, and a fit athletic build. She kneels on a shaggy beige rug, leans toward the overhead camera, and adjusts a high ponytail with both hands. She wears a black sleeveless ribbed top, matching high-waisted black yoga leggings, white pearl necklace, and small gold hoops.
prompt.composition_elements: Extreme overhead 4:5 centered framing focused on face and upper body, with beige faux-fur rug, plain off-white wall, and clean uncluttered space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused daylight or softbox illumination, even bright light with gentle shadows, confident cozy modern polished mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic raw fashion-lifestyle photography, 4:5 framing, 24mm f/1.4 wide-angle perspective, high detail, realistic rug fibers, ribbed fabric, hair strands, and skin pores.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic 4:5 extreme high-angle portrait of an approved adult platinum-blonde woman kneeling on a shaggy beige faux-fur rug in a bright minimalist room. She leans toward the overhead camera and adjusts a high ponytail with both hands. Give her fair natural skin, light green eyes, defined brows, and a fit athletic build.
